The unmodified opl3.c and opl3.h sources are retained in this directory.
Original upstream: https://github.com/nukeykt/Nuked-OPL3
Browser build and adapter: ../../build.py and ../../renderer.cpp.
This is an OPL sound-chip emulator, not an EXE or DOS interpreter.
The Dune II ADL score banks are separately extracted from the user-supplied
SOUND.PAK. See ../../banks.json and ../../PROVENANCE.md.
